meta_description: Maddison Decorators is your trusted painter and decorator in Liverpool. Interior and exterior work, free quotes, reliable service. Call 07377 384688 today.
hero_subhead: From fresh walls to complete room makeovers, we transform homes across Liverpool with attention to detail and reliable service.
services_heading: Painting and Decorating Services Across Liverpool
services_subhead: From interior redecorating to full exterior renovation, we handle every type of painting job with care and expertise.

services.title: Interior Painting & Decorating
services.desc: We refresh your living spaces with high-quality emulsion and specialist finishes. Every room is carefully prepared, taped, and painted to a professional standard.

services.title: Exterior Painting & Rendering
services.desc: Weatherproof your home with exterior masonry paint and rendering work. We prepare surfaces thoroughly and use only durable, weather-resistant paints suited to Liverpool's climate.

services.title: Wallpapering & Wall Coverings
services.desc: Expert wallpaper hanging and feature wall installation. We handle everything from standard paste to premium vinyls and textured coverings.

services.title: Woodwork & Joinery Painting
services.desc: Skirting boards, doors, windows, and frames painted to a flawless finish. We sand, prime, and apply multiple coats for lasting durability.

services.title: Bathroom & Kitchen Repainting
services.desc: Moisture-resistant paints and finishes specifically formulated for wet rooms. Your kitchen and bathroom stay fresh and vibrant for years.

services.title: Commercial Painting
services.desc: Office spaces, retail units, and commercial properties repainted on schedule. We work flexibly around your business hours to minimise disruption.

about_pullquote: A lick of paint shouldn't mean weeks of mess and broken promises.
about_para_1: Maddison Decorators was founded on a simple principle: deliver honest, skilled work at a fair price, on time, every time. With over 15 years' experience transforming homes and businesses across Liverpool, we've built our reputation by doing the job right the first time. Every member of our team takes pride in preparation, finishing, and leaving your home spotless.
about_para_2: We're not a franchise or a faceless chain—we're a local Liverpool business that treats every job as though it's our own home. Our customers return to us because we show up on time, explain what we're doing, and don't disappear half-way through. Whether it's a bedroom makeover or a full house renovation, we deliver the same professional care every time.
reviews_heading: What Liverpool Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Needed my living room done urgently before Christmas. Called Maddison on a Thursday and they were here Monday morning. Two days, three coats, looks brilliant. No fuss, no drama. Would definitely book again.
reviews.author: David P.

reviews.text: Our kitchen and bathroom both needed repainting. The team moved quickly, kept everything tidy, and matched the existing colours perfectly. Fair price too, which was a pleasant surprise. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Sarah M.

reviews.text: First time using decorators in years and was nervous about cowboys, but Maddison came recommended by a friend. Professional, reliable, and the attention to detail was spot on. Cheers lads.
reviews.author: Michael T.
